name: Admin Document Title Column Resize
description: Read long document names without opening them in /panel/documents. In both the table and card gallery, titles are contained on one ellipsized line; the complete collapsed text is always available through a native hover hint, while real clipping exposes the same in-place Ver completo/Contraer control and is remeasured after web fonts finish loading. Folder and accompanying distinctions render in ordered metadata below the title without reserving a blank desktop line for documents without a folder. In list mode, the Título header exposes a visible, labelled and keyboard-accessible drag separator that resizes from 240px to 800px, starts at 320px, persists the chosen width in projectapp-table-widths:documents-list, and resets on double-click. Proyecto, Cliente and Fecha yield space in that order, while Estados and Acciones remain fixed and the table scrolls internally after donor floors are reached.
